text:
Ivy Park: Heads up — APAC catalog reviewer flagged our joint listing with BeaconSI. Theyasked for an apostilled pen-test attestation OR a notarized affidavit with local embassy apostille instructions. cc @Rahul Menon @legal-sig
Rahul Menon: Oof. Do we have any prior apostille handoffs? Last time we relied on partner to get apostille locally.
legal-sig: Correct. Apostilles are country-specific; e-notary covers many cases but not all APAC registries. For an APAC catalog that explicitly requests apostille, the fastest is: we provide e-notarized affidavit + an explicit handoff note that the SI (BeaconSI) will obtain apostille locally if required. That usually satisfies the intake team.
Ivy Park: Marketplace asked for: (1) pen-test exec summary (redacted), (2) signed affidavit stating firmware hash generation method + timestamp, (3) escrow/no-escrow KMS note. They specifically mentioned "apostille preferred for notarized docs."
artifact-bot: Draft manifest created: items -> pen-summary-redacted.pdf (14d), firmware-hash.txt (7d), affidavit-en.pdf (30d), kms-attestation.pdf (90d). Manifest ID: apac-beacon-2076543210.
Sam Lee: Ops note: will generate the firmware hash for firmware v3.1.2 and upload to manifest. Use command:
```
sha256sum runtime-agent-v3.1.2.bin > firmware-hash.txt
cat firmware-hash.txt
```
Ivy Park: Good. Legal, please draft bilingual affidavit (EN + local language note) stating hash and generation steps. Include a clause: "If apostille is required, BeaconSI will request local apostille and notify Redwood."
legal-sig: Drafting now. Recommending e-notary route + partner-assisted apostille. Also suggest adding a short chain-of-custody bullet: who ran the hash, timestamp, bucket path, presign manifest ID.
Rahul Menon: Timeline: reviewer wants inbound package in 48 hours. Who owns what?
Ivy Park: Owners: Sam -> firmware hash upload (due 6h). Rahul -> pen exec summary redaction (due 24h). legal-sig -> affidavit draft + route for e-notary (due EOD). artifact-bot -> generate presigned URLs once uploads complete.
artifact-bot: Presign manifest apac-beacon-2076543210 created with TTLs attached.
Sam Lee: Uploaded firmware-hash.txt (sha256: d4f2a9c1...). File in manifest.
Rahul Menon: Pen exec summary drafted, removed PII and exploit PoCs. Added remediation tracker CSV (not attached, internal). Will attach redacted PDF to manifest by EOD.
legal-sig: Affidavit drafted and routed for e-notary. Note: If marketplace insists on physical apostille, partner should process locally; we'll include instruction page for them.
Ivy Park: Marketplace reply: "We accept e-notarized affidavit for initial review; apostille may be requested before final listing." They asked for contact to follow-up. Provide a single point of contact.
Ivy Park: I'll be contact. Once manifest is shared, I'll DM reviewer and provide a short README explaining redactions and apostille fallback.
artifact-bot: README-apac-beacon.md uploaded to manifest. Manifest sharing link generated.
Marketplace-APAC: Received manifest. We'll start review and may request apostille later. Thanks.
Ivy Park: All items done for initial intake. If reviewer asks for apostille later, BeaconSI to obtain locally. Open items: legal to confirm e-notary receipt format for APAC.
legal-sig: Confirmed. E-notary cert + timestamped PDF accepted by intake; we will keep steps documented for partner apostille if escalation occurs.
Ivy Park: Closing thread for now. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
